description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::beta_distribution class, including serialization, degenerate cases, statistical validation, and implementation-specific tests. It also tests the distribution's stability and algorithm bounds.

classes.name: BetaDistributionInterfaceTest
classes.description: Template test fixture for beta distribution interface tests across different floating point types.

classes.name: BetaDistributionModel
classes.description: Model class for computing theoretical moments of the beta distribution for testing purposes.

classes.name: BetaDistributionTest
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture for statistical validation and stability testing of the beta distribution.

methods.name: SerializeTest
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of beta_distribution objects with various parameters.

methods.name: DegenerateCases
methods.description: Tests beta distribution behavior with extreme and boundary parameter values.

methods.name: TestSampleStatistics
methods.description: Runs statistical tests (mean, variance, chi-squared) on samples generated from the distribution.

methods.name: SingleZTestOnMeanAndVariance
methods.description: Checks if sample mean and variance match theoretical values within error bounds.

methods.name: SingleChiSquaredTest
methods.description: Performs chi-squared goodness-of-fit test on generated samples.

methods.name: StabilityTest
methods.description: Verifies the stability of the distribution implementation against known outputs.
